name: data-database-object-signatures-local-only-api67

evidence.notes: Glade locally executes the Object-typed update overload with allOrNone=false and SYSTEM_MODE.
Glade locally executes the Object-typed delete overload with SYSTEM_MODE.
Glade locally executes the Object-typed undelete overload with SYSTEM_MODE.

source.content: @isTest private class DataDatabaseObjectSignaturesLocalOnlyTest { @isTest static void objectOverloadsRunLocally() { Object insertedObject = new Account(Name = 'Local Object Signatures'); Database.SaveResult inserted = Database.insert(insertedObject, false); Object updatedObject = new Account(Id = inserted.getId(), Name = 'Local Object Signatures Updated'); Database.SaveResult updated = Database.update(updatedObject, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(updated.isSuccess()); Account accessAccount = new Account(Name = 'Local Object Access Signatures'); insert accessAccount; Object accessDeletedObject = accessAccount; Database.DeleteResult accessDeleted = Database.delete(accessDeletedObject, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(accessDeleted.isSuccess()); Object accessRestoredObject = accessDeletedObject; Database.UndeleteResult accessRestored = Database.undelete(accessRestoredObject, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(accessRestored.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Id = :accessAccount.Id]); } }

notes: Local-runtime witness for three Object-typed Database overloads taking AccessLevel, absent from the Salesforce API 67 signature surface.
